name: const unsafe fn copy_nonoverlapping < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
rule: A pointer obtained by casting a reference is guaranteed valid for the relevant access while the underlying object remains live and no reference is used to access the same memory; reference accesses and raw-pointer accesses must not be interleaved.
api: const unsafe fn copy_nonoverlapping < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
